change: India–New Zealand FTA enters into force with new temporary employment pathways and phased graduate/work commitments
status: Implemented; some commitments phased or future-effective
effective_date: TEE pathways from 2026-10-20; Indian PhD post-study work change from 2026-11-16; working-holiday scheme due within 2 years
affected_cohort: Indian nationals in qualifying skilled occupations; eligible Indian PhD graduates; future eligible Indian working-holiday applicants
observed_fact: Immigration New Zealand states the FTA entered into force on 2026-10-20. Two Temporary Employment Entry categories allow up to 5,000 holders in New Zealand at a time; most places are for specified skilled occupations. The visas last 3 years and do not create a residence pathway. From 2026-11-16, Indian PhD graduates become eligible for post-study work visas up to 4 years; a future working-holiday scheme is capped at 1,000 places annually.
pathway_mechanism: Adds selective temporary labour-entry routes and changes post-study work access for a defined nationality/qualification cohort.
directional_eom_impact: Potentially lowers access-friction energy for eligible Indian cohorts; no country-level macro score change assigned.
counterfactual_or_caveat: Selective and cohort-specific; job offer, qualification, English, health, character and other route conditions still apply. The TEE routes do not provide residence. No causal effect estimated.
observation_period: Policy effective from 2026-10-20 or 2026-10-27; some provisions scheduled for 2026-11-16 or within 2 years

change: Unlimited in-study work rights for new master's-by-research students removed; standard 25-hour weekly limit applies during study
affected_cohort: New student visas for master's students with applications made on or after 2026-10-27, including new master's-by-research students
observed_fact: Immigration New Zealand says new master's-by-research students no longer have unlimited in-study work rights; new master's students have the same 25 hours per week during study and full-time work during holidays.
pathway_mechanism: Reduces permitted in-study work hours for the affected new student cohort and may affect income/work-study trade-offs.
directional_eom_impact: Potentially raises cost/constraint energy for the affected cohort; no numeric score assigned.
counterfactual_or_caveat: Applies only to new student visas where applications were made on or after 2026-10-27. Existing visas are not described as retrospectively changed. No causal effect estimated.
observation_period: Policy effective from 2026-10-20 or 2026-10-27; some provisions scheduled for 2026-11-16 or within 2 years

change: English-language ability explicitly named as a key factor in assessing student visa condition compliance
affected_cohort: Student visa applicants and holders whose compliance with student visa conditions is assessed under the strengthened instructions
observed_fact: Immigration New Zealand states that English-language ability is a key factor in determining whether a student can meet student-visa conditions.
pathway_mechanism: Makes language ability more explicit in compliance assessment, potentially affecting evidence requirements and perceived compliance risk.
directional_eom_impact: Direction uncertain; may increase assessment friction for some applicants while clarifying expectations. No numeric score assigned.
counterfactual_or_caveat: The announcement does not quantify refusals or identify an estimated effect on migration outcomes. No causal effect estimated.
observation_period: Policy effective from 2026-10-20 or 2026-10-27; some provisions scheduled for 2026-11-16 or within 2 years

change: Broader authority to suspend processing of student visas while education-provider non-compliance is being determined
affected_cohort: Student visa applicants associated with providers whose compliance is under investigation or determination
observed_fact: Immigration New Zealand states that it can formally suspend processing in a broader range of circumstances, including while non-compliance by an education provider is still being determined.
pathway_mechanism: Can increase processing uncertainty and delay risk for applicants linked to providers under review.
directional_eom_impact: Potentially raises pathway-friction energy for the affected provider-linked cohort; no country-level score assigned.
counterfactual_or_caveat: This does not establish that all student visa applications are suspended or delayed. No causal effect estimated.
observation_period: Policy effective from 2026-10-20 or 2026-10-27; some provisions scheduled for 2026-11-16 or within 2 years

change: Course-end student visa expiry buffer extended from one month to two months where that expiry rule applies
affected_cohort: Student visa holders whose visa expiry is calculated as one month after course end
observed_fact: Immigration New Zealand says the period after course end is extended from one month to two months; the separate 31 March expiry date remains unchanged.
pathway_mechanism: Provides additional time for affected students to decide their next step after finishing study.
directional_eom_impact: Potentially reduces transition-friction energy for affected students; no numeric score assigned.
counterfactual_or_caveat: This is not a post-study work-right extension and does not change the 31 March expiry rule. No causal effect estimated.
observation_period: Policy effective from 2026-10-20 or 2026-10-27; some provisions scheduled for 2026-11-16 or within 2 years
